name: nexus-proxy.dnp.dappnode.eth
shortDescription: Keep your Nexus prompts private, and verify it yourself
description:
Encrypts your Nexus prompts so only the TEE (trusted execution environment) that Nexus runs inside can read them — not us, not Dappnode, nobody in between. It verifies the TEE automatically on every connection.

You do not have to take our word for it: the verification page shows what was checked, right now, and lets you download the raw proof to verify independently. It never shows your prompts.

Point any OpenAI-compatible app on this Dappnode at http://nexus-proxy.dappnode.private:3301/v1 with your normal Nexus API key. Same key, same models, same prices. Some apps, such as Hermes Agent, have a private mode switch that does this for you.

For the whole path, pick a model whose id starts with private/ — those run inside a TEE too, so your prompt stays encrypted from the proxy to Nexus and from Nexus to the model.

Auto Router (nexus/auto) and PII masking do not work through the proxy.
author: DAppNode Association <admin@dappnode.io> (https://github.com/dappnode)

warnings.onInstall: Point your apps at http://nexus-proxy.dappnode.private:3301/v1 with your normal Nexus API key. Auto Router and PII masking do not work through the proxy. If the TEE cannot be verified, requests stop. Keep port 3301 on the internal network.
